subject: VPN client stuck on Verifying peer
body: Since this morning the VPN client hangs at 'Verifying peer' and then reports TLS handshake failed. Worked fine last week. I am the only one on my team seeing it.

subject: Deploy keeps failing in us-east-1
body: Third attempt to deploy checkout-api to prod-east. Event log says INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY on standard-16. Do I need a quota increase?

subject: checkout-api throwing 503s
body: Customers reporting errors on checkout since 09:15. Dashboard shows 503 rate climbing. Traffic is about 3x normal because of a promo.

subject: Private hostname not resolving from worker
body: Worker in staging-west can ping 10.40.2.11 but cannot resolve db.internal.acme.example. Peering shows active in the console.

subject: Health check timeout on new service
body: reports-worker reaches STARTED then DEPLOY_FAILED with HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT. Our app takes about 3 minutes to warm its cache on boot.

subject: Cannot deploy, quota message
body: Deploy rejected instantly with QUOTA_EXCEEDED on vcpu. We have several old sandboxes nobody uses.
resolution: Reclaimed two idle sandboxes, freeing 96 vCPU. Deploy succeeded without a quota increase.

subject: Need the VPN shared key
body: A runbook told me to request the current VPN pre-shared key. Can someone send it over?

subject: Workers restarting in a loop
body: billing-worker in prod-west keeps cycling. Logs show OOMKilled every few minutes. Ready count is bouncing between 0 and 2.
